subject: Spanska 3
title: Introduction to the subjunctive: wishes, necessity and requests
sourceSummary: The present subjunctive after expressions of wish, necessity and request: quiero que, es importante que, espero que.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Quiero que tú ___ (hablar) con ella."
questions.opener: After "quiero que" with a different subject, the subjunctive is required, not the present indicative.
questions.explanation: "Quiero que" + a different subject triggers the subjunctive. -ar verbs in the subjunctive switch their ending to -e: hable, hables, hable, hablemos, habléis, hablen. "Tú" gives "hables".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Es importante que nosotros ___ (comer) verduras."
questions.opener: "Es importante que" is a classic subjunctive expression of necessity. -er verbs switch their ending to -a.
questions.explanation: -er/-ir verbs in the subjunctive take -a endings: coma, comas, coma, comamos, comáis, coman. "Nosotros" gives "comamos".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Espero que tú ___ (tener) suerte."
questions.opener: "Tener" has an irregular subjunctive stem: teng-.
questions.explanation: "Tener" forms the subjunctive on the stem "teng-": tenga, tengas, tenga, tengamos, tengáis, tengan. "Tú" gives "tengas". "Espero que" triggers the subjunctive because it expresses a wish about something uncertain.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Quiero ___ al cine esta noche."
questions.opener: If the SAME person both wishes and carries out the action, the infinitive is used, not que + subjunctive.
questions.explanation: When the subject is the same in both parts ("I want [myself] to go"), the infinitive is used without "que": "quiero ir". "Que" + the subjunctive is only used when the subjects differ, e.g. "quiero que tú vayas".

questions.prompt: Which expression fills the gap and requires the subjunctive: "___ que estudies más."
questions.opener: Which option signals necessity/urging, as opposed to certainty?
questions.explanation: "Es necesario que" expresses necessity and requires the subjunctive in the subordinate clause: "estudies". "Creo", "sé" and "estoy seguro de" instead express certainty/conviction and normally take the indicative, not the subjunctive.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Espero que tú ___ (dormir) bien esta noche."
questions.opener: "Dormir" has the same stem change (o→ue) in the subjunctive as in the present indicative, in most persons.
questions.explanation: "Dormir" in the subjunctive: duerma, duermas, duerma, durmamos, durmáis, duerman (note o→u in "nosotros"/"vosotros", not o→ue). "Tú" gives "duermas".

questions.prompt: Conjugate the verbs in the subjunctive and explain why: "Mis padres quieren que yo ___ (estudiar) medicina, pero mi hermana espera que yo ___ (seguir) mi propio camino. Es importante que nosotros ___ (ser) sinceros sobre lo que queremos."
questions.opener: For each gap, check: does the main clause express wish/necessity, and do the subjects differ?
steps: "Quieren que yo..." expresses the parents' wish about SOMEONE ELSE (me) — the subjects differ, so the subjunctive is used: "estudie" (-ar verb, stem estudi- + e).
"Espera que yo siga" — "seguir" has a stem change (e→i) and is already irregular in the "yo" form (sigo), which carries over into the subjunctive: siga, sigas, siga... "Yo" gives "siga".
"Es importante que nosotros seamos" — "ser" is completely irregular in the subjunctive: sea, seas, sea, seamos, seáis, sean. "Nosotros" gives "seamos".

What all three gaps share: the verb in the clause after "que" is in the subjunctive because the main clause expresses wish/necessity AND the subject of the subordinate clause differs from the subject of the main clause.

questions.prompt: Which expressions trigger the subjunctive, and how is it conjugated?
questions.opener: A list of trigger phrases plus the most common irregular forms.
questions.answer: Expressions that trigger the subjunctive: querer que, esperar que, es importante que, es necesario que, pedir que, recomendar que — all express a wish, necessity, or request directed at SOMEONE ELSE. Rule: same subject → infinitive (quiero ir), different subjects → que + subjunctive (quiero que vayas). Regular endings: -ar → -e/-es/-e/-emos/-éis/-en, -er/-ir → -a/-as/-a/-amos/-áis/-an. Key irregular forms: ser → sea, estar → esté, ir → vaya, saber → sepa, dar → dé, haber → haya, tener → tenga.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Mis padres quieren que yo ___ (llegar) a casa temprano."
questions.opener: Different subjects (mis padres / yo) trigger the subjunctive in the subordinate clause.
questions.explanation: -ar verbs in the subjunctive switch their ending to -e: llegue, llegues, llegue, lleguemos, lleguéis, lleguen. "Yo" gives "llegue".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Espero que tú ___ (hacer) la tarea."
questions.opener: "Hacer" has an irregular subjunctive stem: hag-.
questions.explanation: "Hacer" forms the subjunctive on the stem "hag-": haga, hagas, haga, hagamos, hagáis, hagan. "Tú" gives "hagas".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Es necesario ___ el pasaporte antes de viajar."
questions.opener: Without a specific subject ("que + someone"), the infinitive is used after "es necesario", just like with "quiero".
questions.explanation: "Es necesario" + the infinitive is used for a general statement with no specific subject: "es necesario tener el pasaporte". "Que" + the subjunctive would instead be required if a specific subject were named, e.g. "es necesario que tengas el pasaporte".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "El médico recomienda que ella ___ (dejar) de fumar."
questions.opener: "Recomendar que" is a classic expression of urging that triggers the subjunctive.
questions.explanation: -ar verbs in the subjunctive switch their ending to -e: deje, dejes, deje, dejemos, dejéis, dejen. "Ella" gives "deje".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Ojalá que ellos ___ (ir) a la fiesta."
questions.opener: "Ir" is completely irregular in the subjunctive.
questions.explanation: "Ir" in the subjunctive: vaya, vayas, vaya, vayamos, vayáis, vayan. "Ellos" gives "vayan". "Ojalá que" (I hope that) expresses a wish and requires the subjunctive.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Te pido que me ___ (ayudar)."
questions.opener: "Pedir que" is another common expression of request.
questions.explanation: -ar verbs in the subjunctive: ayude, ayudes, ayude, ayudemos, ayudéis, ayuden. "Tú" (the implied recipient) gives "ayudes".

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "Necesito que tú ___ (venir) mañana."
questions.opener: Different subjects (yo necesito / tú vengas) trigger the subjunctive, and "venir" is irregular.
questions.explanation: "Venir" forms the subjunctive on the stem "veng-": venga, vengas, venga, vengamos, vengáis, vengan. "Tú" gives "vengas".
